records: Intake note
The foundation requested weekly CHF attribution alongside a multicurrency bond mandate and mixed funding.
Exception review

Reporting validation began in week 8. The source feed could not support the requested Monday cutoff. Twelve business days of rework were recorded; this was not necessarily twelve days of overall launch delay.
Decision and outcome

Client Reporting and the RM obtained acceptance of weekly holdings plus a monthly pack. The retrospective recommended capability validation during intake. Benchmark mapping added four business days of work.

records: Intake note
The endowment provided its policy and a draft IMA for a global bond mandate with bespoke ESG restrictions.
Exception review
The exactly-5% tobacco boundary produced different results between the policy and draft contract. Guideline clarification required eight business days of rework.

Legal confirmed >=5%. The team tested below, at and above the threshold, preserved unknown values and documented issuer-parent mapping.

records: Intake note
Mixed cash and existing bonds were proposed for an eight-week launch with FX forwards and rate futures.
Exception review
Three transfer positions required disposition. Counterparty documentation consumed ten business days of additional work and was not ready for the target date.
Decision and outcome
The client and accountable owners approved a staged mandate and retained controls preventing derivative activation before later readiness approval.

records: Intake note
Swiss pension mandate with CHF reporting, weekly attribution, transferred bonds and bespoke exclusions.
Exception review
The team recorded reporting rework of nine business days, guideline clarification of six, transfer remediation of seven and derivatives rework of eight. These workstreams overlapped.
Decision and outcome

A coordinated review agreed report scope, tested the guideline boundary and separated derivative activation from cash-bond readiness. The original date moved by five business days; workstream days must not be added.

historical_cases.name: Rhinebridge Pension Foundation

records: Intake note
The client requested weekly CHF outputs with a global bond and derivative mandate. Funding was entirely cash.
Preventive action
Client Reporting tested a sample and agreed the supported service before the final commercial commitment. Derivatives setup began immediately.
Outcome
No reporting or derivatives exception was recorded. This successful case supports the preventive action, not an assumption that weekly attribution is always feasible.

documents.title: Client request and relationship-manager handover

chunks.heading: Mandate and timetable
chunks.text: Alpenridge Pension Foundation, Zurich, has selected us for a USD-equivalent 250 million global investment-grade bond separate account. Target funding is 23 November 2026. Financial reporting currency is CHF. The account is proposed to receive 200 million of existing bonds plus 50 million cash; these figures are USD equivalents and are not an FX conversion instruction.

chunks.heading: Service request
chunks.text: The trustee pack is discussed on Mondays. Please provide weekly CHF performance, attribution and ESG analytics by Monday 08:00 Zurich, plus the usual month-end pack. The consultant says another Swiss pension client receives weekly reporting. Please check the exact service before confirming that we can match it.

chunks.heading: Restrictions and launch scope
chunks.text: The investment policy excludes tobacco at five percent or more, and says no thermal coal. FX forwards and interest-rate futures are wanted from day one. The attached IMA may still contain an earlier tobacco threshold. Client wants to understand watch areas and the route to readiness before making further commitments.

chunks.heading: Planning question
chunks.text: Which previous cases actually help us, what is different about this mandate, and which decisions should we bring forward? Please return a tailored plan with evidence and named human decision owners. Do not send anything to the client or create execution tasks yet.

documents.title: Draft IMA — Schedule A, investment guidelines and service annex

chunks.heading: Tobacco exclusion
chunks.text: The Manager shall not purchase securities issued by companies deriving more than 5% of annual revenue from tobacco production. The schedule is silent on parent aggregation, data provider and unavailable revenue data.

chunks.heading: Thermal coal exclusion
chunks.text: Investment in companies involved in thermal coal is prohibited. This draft does not define extraction, power generation, distribution, a revenue threshold, or treatment of mixed business models.

chunks.heading: Reporting and derivatives
chunks.text: Weekly CHF performance, attribution and ESG analytics shall be delivered by Monday 08:00 Zurich. FX forwards and interest-rate futures are within the proposed permitted instruments. This document is unsigned; client correspondence alone does not update the contract.

chunks.heading: Draft precedence
chunks.text: This is IMA draft version 3, not an executed instruction. Resolve conflicts against the client policy with Legal and the client. Prior client contract language is a precedent for review, not authority to modify this mandate.

documents.title: Trustee investment policy — approved client policy excerpt

chunks.heading: Threshold and scope
chunks.text: Exclude companies deriving 5% or more of revenue from tobacco production. No thermal coal. The policy contains no explicit issuer-parent methodology, provider designation, stale-data rule, or definition of thermal-coal involvement.

chunks.heading: Portfolio objectives
chunks.text: Global investment-grade fixed income with CHF investor reporting. A 5% single corporate-issuer limit is proposed; sovereign issuers are exempt from this cap only. Client-specific interpretation of excluded activities remains necessary.

chunks.heading: Authority
chunks.text: This policy was approved by the fictional trustees. Legal must reconcile it with the unsigned IMA; the onboarding assistant cannot infer a new exclusion threshold or treat the more restrictive rule as automatically authorized.

documents.title: Indicative transfer list and data-quality note

chunks.heading: Funding arithmetic
chunks.text: Indicative funding: USD-equivalent 200 million securities and 50 million cash, total 250 million. Twelve positions comprise two sovereigns of 55 million and 45 million, plus ten corporate bonds of 10 million each. Each corporate holding is 4% of the total proposed 250 million NAV.

chunks.heading: Potential watch positions
chunks.text: Alder Tobacco Holdings: tobacco production 5.0%, thermal-coal extraction 0%, value 10 million. Granite Basin Resources: tobacco 0%, coal extraction 12%, value 10 million. Meridian Industrials: tobacco revenue missing, coal revenue missing, value 10 million. All names and identifiers are fictional.

chunks.heading: Data limits and disposition
chunks.text: The other seven corporate issuers have known tobacco and coal-extraction revenue of 0%. Values are indicative and do not establish settlement eligibility. A missing field is unknown, not zero. No sale, rejection, retention or cash substitution has been authorized. Quantify scenarios and obtain client/PM decisions before transition instructions.

documents.title: Opportunity prerequisites and planning boundary

chunks.heading: Prerequisites
chunks.text: For this synthetic scenario only, the opportunity is won and IO vetting, CORG and applicable DAG/IOR approvals are recorded complete. Guideline, compliance, reporting and benchmark briefs have been returned with watch areas. Returned briefs do not establish that every open service question is resolved.

chunks.heading: Ownership and systems
chunks.text: GCS Operations coordinates the plan; FI PAG coordinates the investment-side discussion; FI PC owns investment guideline implementation review. Execution remains in Appian and existing systems. Investor financial-account creation follows the Appian-to-Salesforce integration. This demonstration ends at a human-reviewed proposed workflow.

chunks.heading: Scope
chunks.text: Use the five broad phases: information intake, account paperwork, operational setup, funding and post-funding. The seven workstreams can overlap. Propose which tasks move earlier because of the evidence; do not invent a universal order or an automatic release gate.

documents.title: Custodian sample-feed feasibility response

chunks.heading: Current feed
chunks.text: Orion Custody is a fictional service provider. Its indicative file for this mandate arrives Tuesday 06:00 Zurich and contains positions, currencies and prices. It does not contain transaction-level attribution inputs, benchmark returns or issuer ESG metrics.

chunks.heading: Unresolved onboarding checks
chunks.text: We can supply an anonymized-format sample for reconciliation. The final account-level entitlements, identifiers and exception routing have not yet been tested. A sample-delivery statement is not acceptance of an ongoing service-level commitment.

documents.title: Client clarification — weekly means holdings

chunks.heading: Scope correction
chunks.text: To clarify our trustee request: weekly CHF holdings on Tuesday by 12:00 is acceptable. Performance, attribution and ESG analytics can be monthly on the fifth business day. Please amend the draft reporting annex accordingly. We have not changed the investment restrictions, funding mix or requested derivatives.

chunks.heading: Remaining decisions
chunks.text: We still want a representative sample before acceptance of the service. Our email authorizes preparation of an amendment; the agreement must go through the usual signatures.

documents.title: Client transition alternative — cash funding and later derivatives

chunks.heading: Revised proposal
chunks.text: Use USD-equivalent 250 million cash at inception. We will retain the legacy securities with the outgoing manager; do not transfer them. We accept planning for a cash-bond launch, with derivatives proposed for day 30 subject to investment-team suitability review, documentation and readiness. The reporting clarification in N07 remains in force.

chunks.heading: Limits
chunks.text: This is a proposed revision requiring the IMA and implementation plan to align. Bespoke ESG restrictions remain unchanged. All-cash funding removes the proposed in-kind transfer screen from the launch path; it does not remove restrictions from subsequent purchases. Day 30 is a target, not a guarantee.

documents.title: Reporting service capability matrix

chunks.heading: Available service
chunks.text: For the synthetic global IG bond platform, CHF holdings can be produced weekly on Tuesday by 12:00, subject to a validated source feed. Validated performance, attribution and ESG analytics are available monthly on the fifth business day. Weekly analytics by Monday 08:00 are not a supported standard service.

chunks.heading: Dependency and approval
chunks.text: Attribution needs validated transactions, benchmark returns, currency calculations and reconciliation. Holdings availability alone does not prove attribution feasibility. A bespoke weekly service requires a separate feasibility assessment and authorized commercial/service acceptance; no committed build date exists.

chunks.heading: Version authority
chunks.text: Version 2 supersedes O02 for new onboarding plans. Historical examples remain useful for failure patterns and preventive actions, but cannot establish current platform capability.

documents.title: Archived reporting capability — pilot description

chunks.heading: Pilot wording
chunks.text: Weekly CHF reporting is available for selected pension accounts in a controlled pilot. Coverage and manual preparation depend on the client feed. This sentence does not define holdings versus attribution.

chunks.heading: Retirement notice
chunks.text: Superseded by O01. The manual pilot was not adopted as the standard service. Do not use this archived wording to make a new-client reporting commitment.

documents.title: Guideline implementation dictionary and rule-change controls

chunks.heading: Field semantics
chunks.text: TOB_PROD_REV_PCT: annual tobacco-production revenue percentage at the selected issuer mapping level. COAL_EXTRACT_REV_PCT: thermal-coal extraction revenue percentage. COAL_POWER_REV_PCT is a different field; extraction cannot stand in for generation. Missing provider values must remain null.

chunks.heading: Interpretation required
chunks.text: Legal and FI PC must confirm activity definition, threshold operator, denominator, issuer/parent scope, provider, as-of date, missing-data behavior, passive breaches and any exemptions. Prior implementation code is evidence of one client interpretation, not a current instruction.

chunks.heading: Candidate validation
chunks.text: Test below, at and above each threshold; missing and stale data; direct and parent mappings; and corporate/sovereign scope. Draft pseudocode is not native CSTAR code and cannot be loaded without review. This demo uses a proposed >30-calendar-day stale-data review threshold solely as an example for approval.

documents.title: Transition and derivatives readiness note

chunks.heading: Parallel preparation
chunks.text: Request indicative holdings and data-quality fields during intake. Obtain Legal/FI PC interpretation before a definitive exclusion screen. Custody and market-access work may proceed in parallel, but unresolved securities must have a client-approved disposition.

chunks.heading: Derivatives dependency
chunks.text: FX forwards and rate futures require relevant documentation, counterparty/broker and operational readiness. A staged bond-only plan is an option only if PM and client accept the investment implications and enforceable controls prevent premature activation.

chunks.heading: Schedule use
chunks.text: Case-study rework days measure workstream effort or elapsed remediation in the source record, not additive launch delay. Build an owner-reviewed dependency plan. Without current capacity, external response times and dated readiness evidence, no calibrated launch-date prediction is supported.

documents.title: Swiss-client review routing note

chunks.heading: Country-specific review
chunks.text: Swiss domicile and CHF reporting are routing signals for Legal and Client Reporting review. This fictional note does not assert a Swiss law requiring weekly reporting, a particular tax form or a specific investor classification. The weekly requirement in this case originates from the client request.

chunks.heading: Open classification questions
chunks.text: Ask Legal to verify the entity, governing documents, permitted service and applicable requirements using authoritative current sources in a real onboarding. No regulation corpus is included in this synthetic demo. The assistant must report this evidence gap rather than invent a country-specific legal requirement.

documents.title: Alpinecrest — accepted reporting annex

chunks.heading: Accepted definition
chunks.text: The accepted service was weekly CHF holdings on Tuesday and a monthly validated performance/attribution pack. Weekly attribution was the initial request, not the ultimately delivered service.

chunks.heading: Operational difference
chunks.text: The historical custodian supplied its positions on Monday evening and used an earlier reporting platform. Its timing and manual steps cannot establish current readiness for the Orion feed.

documents.title: Northbridge — restriction redline and implementation review

chunks.heading: Contract comparison
chunks.text: Client policy: 5% or more tobacco production revenue. Unsigned IMA: more than 5%. Approved Northbridge wording: 5% or more. The difference affected the exactly-5% boundary and required explicit client/Legal confirmation.

chunks.heading: Approved implementation in that case
chunks.text: Compare TOB_PROD_REV_PCT >= 5 on the approved issuer-parent mapping. Missing or stale values enter manual review. The historical client approved a 30-calendar-day data-age threshold. Those provider, mapping and freshness choices do not automatically apply to Alpenridge.

chunks.heading: Coal limitation
chunks.text: Northbridge did not implement a thermal-coal restriction. Its tobacco code provides no evidence for a coal threshold or the meaning of involvement.

documents.title: Seabrook — staged transition decision

chunks.heading: Client choice
chunks.text: The client retained three unresolved positions outside the new account and substituted cash. The PM accepted a bond-only start while derivative documentation completed. Ten business days of derivative rework did not mean an automatic ten-day launch delay.

chunks.heading: Limits on reuse
chunks.text: The team assessed currency and duration implications and enforced a derivative restriction until later readiness approval. A new pension mandate requires its own suitability and client decision; copying this decision would bypass accountability.

documents.title: Rhinebridge — service acceptance and successful outcome

chunks.heading: Requested versus accepted
chunks.text: The intake used the phrase weekly attribution. During week 1 the client accepted weekly CHF holdings on Tuesday with monthly performance, attribution and ESG analytics. A sample was tested before the agreement was finalized.

chunks.heading: Counterevidence
chunks.text: No reporting rework was recorded. This is a successful preventive-action case. It does not demonstrate weekly attribution capability. Keep it in a cohort of initial requests for weekly attribution; exclude it from any claim that full weekly attribution was delivered.

chunks.heading: Funding difference
chunks.text: Funding was cash-only and the guideline schedule was standard. This case is useful for service-scope resolution; it is weak evidence for transferred holdings or bespoke ESG interpretation.

documents.title: Cedar Vale — coal interpretation and data exceptions

chunks.heading: Coal interpretation in this case
chunks.text: Cedar Vale explicitly approved thermal-coal extraction revenue >=10%, with power generation out of scope for that mandate. Its client specified parent aggregation. This is a negotiated client rule, not an industry definition of no thermal coal.

chunks.heading: Unresolved issuer data
chunks.text: One issuer lacked ESG revenue classifications and another required parent mapping. Unknown values went to review; they were not treated as zero. Early review enabled the client to select cash substitution.

chunks.heading: Reuse limit
chunks.text: Offer the definition and test pattern as an option for Alpenridge review. Do not infer that no thermal coal permits up to 10% or excludes only extraction; the new client could intend any involvement, generation as well, or a named issuer list.
